tools.name: get_dispute
tools.description: Get one dispute from disputes.online by its id or page URL: the question, how it will be decided, the outcomes, how the stakes are split between them, and the deadlines. Also finds a dispute that has already been settled and returns which outcome won next to how the crowd had bet — use it to check a

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories disputes on disputes.online are filed under, as a flat tree. Use it to find the category_id for a topic before calling search_disputes.

tools.name: search_disputes
tools.description: List disputes on disputes.online that are open to bets, with each outcome's share of the stakes. Filter by language, category and country; sort by pool size, number of bets or closing time. Use it to find what people are currently predicting about a topic, or what the crowd thinks the odds are.

tools.name: search_disputes_by_tags
tools.description: Find open disputes on disputes.online by tag. Use it for a specific subject — a person, a team, an asset — when category and country are too coarse.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the categories disputes on disputes.online are filed under, as a flat tree. Use it to find the category_id for a topic before calling search_disputes.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dispute · Public sink: search_disputes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dispute · Public sink: search_disputes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
